candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to always return false for IERC1155 interface ID by removing that disjunct, so some interface checks that previously returned true will now return false.

Change the require that forbids zero address to instead allow zero address by removing the require and returning balances[address(0)][id] (i.e., delete the require check), so balanceOf(address(0), id) no longer reverts and returns stored value.
Invert the zero-address check so that calling balanceOf with a non-zero account reverts instead, changing returned values for any normal account.
Return the balance of a different token id (id + 1) instead of the requested id, causing callers to get a different value for most ids.
Always return zero regardless of stored balances, changing observed behavior for any positive balance.
Return double the stored balance (multiply by 2) to expose a different numeric result.
